_what: GitHub's answer for a resource of an organization that has not approved the OAuth app — the message the owner's live account was refused with on 2026-09-20 (T-077), transcribed with the org pseudonymised to the fixture set's `shale-line`. It is a RULE, not a recording (docs/provider-practices.md section 3): the scenario injects it over every read under that org between two syncs, and the success-path recordings underneath stay as they are. The rate-limit headers are the real response's, so the classifier has to read the body and not mistake a refusal for an exhausted limit.

body.message: Although you appear to have the correct authorization credentials, the `shale-line` organization has enabled OAuth App access restrictions, meaning that data access to third-parties is limited. For more information on these restrictions, including how to enable this app, visit https://docs.github.com/articles/restricting-access-to-your-organization-s-data/
